Before you decide

Questions owners ask us

Is this a terrace or semi-D factory?

Neither. Every CRE8 unit is a fully detached factory on its own land — between 0.99 and 1.25 acres — with setbacks all around for vehicle turning and loading.

What's included inside the building?

A ground-level production area with 12-metre ceiling height and 3-tonne floor loading, ground- and first-floor offices, canteen, washrooms and surau, plus front loading access. Type B adds side ramps; Type C sits on a corner with a ramp.

How do I get there today, and what's coming?

Access today is via the Sungai Buaya Interchange on the North–South Expressway. A future connection within Novva Industrial Park towards the Bukit Beruntung Interchange is targeted for Q1 2028 (subject to authority and infrastructure progress). The future ECRL Bandar Serendah station is approx. 8 km away.

What's the price range?

With the current 10% + 10% rebate package, net prices start from RM 7,988,000 (Type A, 0.99 acre) up to RM 8,998,400 (Type C corner) — RM 340–350 per sq ft of built-up area. SPA prices range from RM 9,985,000 to RM 11,248,000. See the full chart above.

Can I pick a specific lot?

Yes — lots are numbered on the site plan. Select the ones you like above and we'll walk you through each of them during your viewing. Popular positions like corner lots are limited (9 in total).

What about tenure, financing and timelines?

We'll prepare a lot-specific breakdown for you — tenure, payment schedule and financing options — at your viewing, so you get exact answers for the lot you're considering.
